title: Easy Melee Tempo
description: Lightweight mod that only allows attack swings at full strength
body:
## About

EasyMeleeTempo is a lightweight, **clientside only** mod that only allows you to attack when your strength gauge is full. Weak swings are cancelled to let you 'spam click' attacks. Note: This does **not** let you attack any faster, it just makes it easier for you to time your attacks.

## Configuration

EasyMT has 4 modes of operation:

- Disabled: Attack timing is never regulated
- Enabled on Shift: Attack timing is only regulated when shift is held
- Disabled on Shift: Attack timing is regulated unless shift is held
- Always on: Attack timing always regulated

You can change this mode in the easymt-client.toml config file, or for easier changes use the `/easymt` command. `/easymt current` will show you your current mode and `/easymt mode [DISABLED/ENABLED_ON_SHIFT/DISABLED_ON_SHIFT/ALWAYS_ON]` will change modes.
